name: Targeted persona probe
definition: Evaluates one targeted probe response against a specific persona contract facet before live tutor robustness.

score_scales.5: Probe response strongly matches the targeted contract facet.
score_scales.3: Probe response partially matches but is generic or shallow.
score_scales.1: Probe response contradicts the targeted contract facet.

aggregation_formula: probe pass rate by persona, facet, task pressure, and model
